As so many of the young Duelists have heard, next year a special World Championship will be held for young Dragon Duelists who excelled at the World Championship Qualifier. I asked a bunch of this weekend’s Dragon Duelists whether the announcement of the new Dragon Duel Championship influenced their decision to compete in Dragon Duels. Check out their answers!
“No, I was trying to play in as many Dragon Duels as possible already, because in January I’m turning 13!” –Zachary Leverett
“I think yes. I’ll probably go to more YCSes to try to beat out the competition.” –Benjamin Leverett
“It doesn’t really change anything at all. I’m still pretty much going to go to all of them.” –Oliver Tomajko
“No, I didn’t even know about it until today. I was coming anyway.” –Chase Fulmer

“Yeah, the Main Event is way tougher, and there’s good prizes at Nats. All the good Dragon Duelists from last year turned 13, so they won’t be able to play. I think I have a really good chance this year.” –Tommy Rowe
